question: Should publisher follow notifications land as this core stacked feature after the API/proof blockers are fixed, or should the notification slice pause until the base follow API direction is accepted?
rationale: The implementation adds new private user state, publish-time fanout, and notification product behavior, so automation can identify blockers but cannot choose the permanent follow-notification product boundary.

options.title: Land the base stack first
options.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 and https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2957 to clear proof and merge/rebase before this notification slice gets final review.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Maintainers can review the API, controls, and notifications as one feature stack, owning the combined private-state and fanout boundary.

options.title: Pause notification delivery
options.body: Keep or close this notification PR until the follow graph product/API shape is accepted independently.

recommendation.title: Land the base stack first
recommendation.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 and https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2957 to clear proof and merge/rebase before this notification slice gets final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-main history on publish gating, schema, retention, and the package/skill publish paths this PR hooks into.
